name: @adrkit/agent-plugin
description: Portable agent plugin exposing adrkit decision memory and evidence-backed ADR backfill to GitHub Copilot CLI, Claude Code, APM, and opencode.
//private: Deliberately private, unlike the sibling Spec Kit adapter. Every host that consumes this installs it from git — `copilot plugin install mbeacom/adrkit:packages/adapters/agent-plugin`, a marketplace entry, or `apm install`. Nothing installs a plugin from npm, so publishing it would create a second, staler distribution path for the same bytes. This file exists so the directory is a real workspace member with a typecheck script and a version that can be asserted against the two manifests.
//versioning: Independently versioned per ADR-0007: the semver contract is with the plugin hosts, not with @adrkit/core, so this does not move with the repository release tag. `version` here must equal `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` and `apm.yml` — Claude Code keys its plugin cache on that field, so a shipped change with a stale version is a change users never receive. Asserted by test/manifest.test.ts.
//dependencies: Deliberately none, including devDependencies. `copilot plugin install ./packages/adapters/agent-plugin` copies this directory; a single declared dependency is enough for Bun's isolated linker to create a node_modules/ here that then rides along into the install. Same rule, and same reason, as packages/adapters/spec-kit. Enforced by test/packaging.test.ts.
